application.name: Stereo Camera
application.description: Runs holoscan-stereo-camera's StereoCameraOp from an Intel RealSense, a side-by-side V4L2 camera or a recording, checks every frame's left, right, RGB and depth images and calibration, and can show the images in a HoloViz window. A synthetic recording with known disparity makes a run that needs no camera.

changelog.1.0.0: Initial release: the holoscan-stereo-camera demo, with the realsense, v4l2-sbs and playback backends, a reporter that checks every frame and the synthetic camera's images, and a HoloViz display of the left, right and RGB images.

hardware.name: NVIDIA GPU
hardware.description: A CUDA-capable GPU supported by the Holoscan SDK.

hardware.name: Intel RealSense
hardware.description: A RealSense with two infrared cameras, for the realsense mode, which needs the module built with librealsense, and a display for its window.

hardware.name: Side-by-side stereo camera
hardware.description: A V4L2 camera that sends both eyes in one YUYV or gray frame, such as a ZED, with its calibration file, for the v4l2-sbs mode.

data.name: Stereo camera recording
data.description: A recording in the module's format, for the playback mode: stereo_camera_record writes one from a camera.

realsense.description: Show the first RealSense's infrared pair and color image, projector on, for 300 frames, checking every frame and printing the factory calibration.

v4l2-sbs.description: Show a side-by-side V4L2 camera at /dev/video0, 2560x720 YUYV, with the calibration file in the data directory, for 300 frames.

playback.description: Play the recording in the data directory once, checking every frame.

ci.description: Finite headless check without a camera or data: a synthetic recording with known disparity, written at run time, played through StereoCameraOp with rgb and depth, every image checked against the synthetic camera.
